rules.name: Retrofit removed CORBA modules (org.omg.*) with standalone GlassFish CORBA
rules.description: Java SE 11 removes the java.corba module (JEP 320). The org.omg.CORBA, org.omg.CosNaming, org.omg.PortableServer and related packages no longer exist in the JDK runtime image, so any source referencing org.omg.* fails to compile on JDK 11. The JEP confirms standalone CORBA implementations are available (GlassFish CORBA / RMI-IIOP stewardship moved to the Eclipse Foundation) and must be deployed on the class path.

patterns.reason: org.omg.* (CORBA API) classes were removed from the JDK in Java SE 11 (JEP 320); references no longer compile without a standalone CORBA implementation on the class path.

rules.verification_hint: After retrofit, 'ant jade' on JDK 11 must compile FIPA/*.java and jade/mtp/iiop/*.java against lib/corba/*.jar and produce BUILD SUCCESSFUL; jade.jar must contain the FIPA stub classes.
